title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Rain of Mercy Pharaoh's Servant PSV-065 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for any collector or player. The Rain of Mercy card, with the card number PSV-065, is a 1st Edition Common card from the Pharaoh's Servant set. It features the Spell-Normal card type and belongs to the Attribute/MTG:Color category. 

With its unique character design, this card is perfect for anyone who wants to add a rare and valuable card to their collection. Whether you're a seasoned player or a beginner, this card is a great addition to your deck. Don't miss the chance to own this amazing card!
